packageRules.description: Open the weekly lock file refresh before majors, so a backlog of majors under the 3-PR cap never starves it
The dupes-isolated CI service container must match production (supabase/postgres 15.8.x -> postgres:15.8); never auto-bump it
Runtime-critical packages: one PR each, kept out of the weekly all-non-major group
Stay on the Node 24 LTS line: no Node 25+ (and no @types/node past 24). Production runs Node 24 from /opt/node-24 (docs/RUNBOOK.md); moving to another line is a deliberate decision, not a bot PR

Deferred on purpose: @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.x moves the Messages API to API version 2026-10-21 and sends the key as an Authorization header. No code impact found, but it is the invoice-extraction path and cannot be exercised without a live call on the production key. Return condition: docs/RUNBOOK.md, section on deferred upgrades
Deferred on purpose: TypeScript 7 breaks lint (typescript-eslint peer range is <6.1.0, eslint-config-next throws at load). Return condition: docs/RUNBOOK.md, section on deferred upgrades

Deferred on purpose: pnpm 11+ is a toolchain migration (the pnpm field in package.json is no longer read, strictDepBuilds, minimumReleaseAge, verifyDepsBeforeRun), not a bump. The 10.34 line is still patched. Return condition: docs/RUNBOOK.md, section on deferred upgrades
react and react-dom must move together, in their own PR
